title: Passage BIO, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Passage Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, announcing a workforce restructuring plan that will reduce headcount by approximately 75% as part of its ongoing strategic alternatives review. The company expects to incur approximately $3.3 million in severance and exit costs, recorded primarily in Q2 2026, with implementation expected to be substantially complete by Q2-Q3 2026.
key_points: Passage Bio announced a 75% workforce reduction as part of its strategic alternatives review
Restructuring Plan implementation expected to be substantially complete in Q2 and Q3 2026
Estimated aggregate severance and exit costs of approximately $3.3 million, recorded primarily in Q2 2026
Impacted employees eligible for severance benefits contingent on execution of severance agreement with general release of claims
Company is a Nasdaq-listed (PASG) emerging growth company incorporated in Delaware
The restructuring is part of previously announced efforts to review strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value
